SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_sales_ngn) / 1, 2) AS net_sales_ngn, ROUND(SUM(cogs_ngn) / 1, 2) AS cogs_ngn, ROUND(SUM(wastage_ngn) / 1, 2) AS wastage_ngn, ROUND(SUM(opex_ngn) / 1, 2) AS opex_ngn, ROUND(SUM(profit_ngn) / 1, 2) AS profit_ngn FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.daily_pnl WHERE day BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'

SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(l.discount_ngn), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn
FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.sale_lines l JOIN lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.sales s ON s.sale_id = l.sale_id
JOIN lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.promos p ON p.promo_id = l.promo_id
WHERE CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' AND CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) > p.end_date

SELECT l.line_id AS record_id FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.sale_lines l
